From the French word for 'sweeping,' balayage has become a popular free-hand technique that is used to 'paint' or 'sweep' colour directly into your hair. Balayage involves hand-painting colour for a seamless blend, creating a natural sun-kissed effect without harsh lines. If you want soft-looking hair without the maintenance, then balayage is the way to go. Balayage can work beautifully across different hair colours, from blonde and light brown shades to deeper tones like brunette hair or chocolate browns and it can be tailored for dark blonde and golden blonde too. Whether you have fine hair or thicker hair, we'll place lighter strands to create subtle depth and a beautiful contrast that looks effortless. For those with darker skin tones or medium skin tones, we can recommend multi-tonal shades that complement your complexion, while a lighter hue often suits pale skin. Balayage is a more natural blending technique for a subtler, sun-kissed look, while ombre hair typically has a more dramatic gradient, with a strong contrast between the darker roots and the lighter ends. Compared to other colouring techniques, balayage is designed to avoid harsh lines and give you soft regrowth without harsh regrowth lines.
